rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Official Scorer
card.instruction: Treat standards, margins, and fine distinctions as your craft. Correct how success is measured before allowing anyone to claim it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't claim longest scarf until we've measured without stretching it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's obviously longer than yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you won't mind laying both flat against this tape.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours only reaches because of the tassels.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quite right. Separate fringe measurements. I may have to surrender overall length and retain decorative reach.

card.title: Official Scorer
card.instruction: Treat standards, margins, and fine distinctions as your craft. Correct how success is measured before allowing anyone to claim it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I certify your cake as tallest, does that sixty centimetres include the stand?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Ten centimetres of stand. But I've already ordered the banner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the cake is fifty. The banner can't count the furniture.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put a ten-centimetre sponge underneath. Can you hold this end?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. Then we'll measure again under its own weight. I'm not certifying the height of my hands.

card.title: Keeper of the Stakes
card.instruction: Remain understated while controlling the reward, penalty, deadline, or condition that determines what winning actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on winning the raffle. The prize is this hamper, once you've returned the basket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need the basket to carry everything home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can borrow it until six. I'll keep the chocolates as a deposit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My bus doesn't get back until seven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Seven is fine. I'll need the wine as well.

card.title: Keeper of the Stakes
card.instruction: Remain understated while controlling the reward, penalty, deadline, or condition that determines what winning actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've won the office parking space. It's yours from nine until five.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I work nights. Could I have it from five until nine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. You'll collect the car-park keys from me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Perfect. I'll be the last one out in the morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you can lock up. I'll need the keys back at nine, once you've checked all three floors.

transfer.response: An inch can be the whole outcome. {counter}
transfer.closing: Close is a measurement. Enough is the ruling you haven't justified.

transfer.action: I keep the prize box closed beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Winning depends on what I put in here. {request}
transfer.response: We'll agree on my conditions before collecting anything. {counter}
transfer.closing: And now it needs the person who decides what the result is worth.
